title: Heap / Top K
intuition: Use a heap of fixed size K to find top/bottom K elements in dynamic datasets in O(n log k) time.
step_by_step_strategy: Initialize min-heap (for largest K) or max-heap (for smallest K).
If heap size exceeds K, pop element.
Remaining heap elements represent top K.
common_mistakes: Using max-heap instead of min-heap to find largest K (causes O(n log n))
Not converting types correctly in Python (heapq is min-heap by default)
complexity: Time: O(n log k), Space: O(k)
content: Use a heap of fixed size K to find top/bottom K elements in dynamic datasets in O(n log k) time.
